entities.name: Hans Tausen's Church

entities.summary: Hans Tausen's Church is a Church of Denmark parish church in the Islands Brygge neighbourhood of Copenhagen, Denmark. It is named after Hans Tausen, the leading theologian of the Danish Reformation.
